# Animal Farm

> Interactive, top-down creature studies for the web (a frog pond first), the
> method for building them, and the QA harness that measures them. The method's
> single source of truth is docs/CREATURE_STUDY_SPEC.md: numbered MUST/SHOULD
> rules, TypeScript interfaces, a file layout, a build procedure, a locomotion
> catalogue, environment design, performance rules and a QA table in which every
> check names the npm script that measures it.

Start with the spec. The frog pond (packages/frog-pond) is its worked example.
No sound anywhere. The frog study has two variants, Night and Day (theme keys
`night` and `day`; titles Night Chorus and Day Chorus). Code is MIT; docs are
CC BY 4.0.

## Docs

- [Creature Study Spec](docs/CREATURE_STUDY_SPEC.md): the rules, interfaces, layout, procedure and QA table (source of truth)
- [Creature Study Field Manual](docs/CREATURE_STUDY_FIELD_MANUAL.html): the illustrated human edition of the spec, with figures
- [Frog art direction](docs/FROG_ART_DIRECTION.md): what each frog pose and scene element must read as, with timings
- [Frog study guide](docs/FROG_STUDY_GUIDE.md): a plain tour of the frog pond's code and how to change common things
- [Audit report](docs/audit-report.html): the 2026-09-25 frog pond audit (26 findings, all addressed or superseded)

## Code

- [packages/frog-pond](packages/frog-pond/README.md): the framework-free study; `mountFrogScene()`, the theme, the world and shore maths
- [studies/frogs](studies/frogs/index.html): the demo page (Night | Day), built by scripts/build.mjs
- [standalone/frogs/entry.ts](standalone/frogs/entry.ts): the single offline HTML file's script (scripts/build-standalone.mjs)
- [qa/README.md](qa/README.md): the QA checks (`npm run qa:*`), thresholds and how to run them

## Working in this repo

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for coding agents (also CLAUDE.md)
- [README.md](README.md): setup, scripts and layout
